scope.boundary: Protocol IR proposal only. No wire stack, no host execution, no proof claim.
scope.authority: existing typed EFSM IR remains sole authority; new operators are expressed as IR nodes with fixed operand/result types and total-or-explicit-failure semantics.
scope.profile: bounded-wire-profile-v1: total packet <=512 bytes (IPv4 min header20 + UDP max payload84 + pad), superset of existing 4096-byte per-buffer domain only for the wire byte-array length (buffer capacity 4096 unchanged); intermediate pseudoheader fixed16 bytes; any length that would exceed wire cap rejects with explicit failure, never truncates.
scope.split: Pure checksum/byte arithmetic as reusable IR ops; UDP- and IPv4-specific policy (zero->65535 transmit mapping, absent-checksum acceptance, pseudoheader field layout) as explicit IR expressions composed by the protocol model, not baked into arithmetic ops.

new_ir_operators.domain: 0<=offset and offset+2<=bytes_len(x); else Uncovered(ModelError) with explicit UncoveredWire, no wrap
always total; appends single 0x00 iff bytes_len odd
bytes_len must be even (callers use bw_zero_pad_even); internal carry folds to low16 with end-around carry; 0<=result<=65535; modulo-2^16 ones-complement add, no sign interpretation
0<=x<=65535; result=(~x & 0xFFFF) with 0->0xFFFF mapping NOT applied here (pure arithmetic)
src,dst each bytes_len==4; length 0<=x<=65535; returns 12-byte array [src||dst||0x00||0x11||u16be(length)]
(src4,dst4,udp_segment); computes ones_sum16(pseudoheader(protocol=17,length=bytes_len(seg)) || zero_pad_even(seg)); then bw_ones_complement16; then transmit-map: if 0 -> 65535
new_ir_operators.failure: non-even handled by internal pad; length>65535 -> ModelError

new_ir_operators.domain: transmitted c==0 means absent -> result true (policy); else verify ones_sum16(ph||pad(seg)) combined with c yields all-ones complement (ones_sum16 result==0xFFFF); no host substitution

model_schema_delta.expression_extension: these ops remain dict{op,args} nodes; no callbacks, no eval, no host functions

wire_profile.overflow_policy: reject Uncovered/ModelError, no truncation, no capacity relaxation
wire_profile.scalar_widths: u8 in [0,255]; u16 in [0,65535]; int unbounded (host-width free); seq32 unchanged
wire_profile.signed64_note: not introduced by these ops; existing int le/ge remains. If a future signed64 slice needed, additive operator only

model_schema_delta.checksum_policy_fields: purely arithmetic results are 0..65535; transmit-map (0->65535) and absent-checksum acceptance are protocol-level IR expressions, explicitly flagged, per RFC sources treated as data

reference_plan.per_operator: Pure host-language deterministic functions over list[int]; each validates domain, raises UncoveredWire or ModelError; no I/O, no randomness.
reference_plan.bw_ones_sum16: fold pairs of big-endian u16, accumulate with end-around carry after each add and final fold, mask 0xFFFF.
reference_plan.udp4_*: compose bw_* ops; udp4_checksum_compute returns arithmetic complement then applies the explicit transmit-map as a separate step (label: transmit_policy). reference returns post-policy value with tag noting policy applied
reference_plan.udp4_checksum_verify: c==0 -> true (absent); else ones_sum16(ph||pad(seg)) == 0xFFFF. Document that reference accepts per profile.
reference_plan.fuzz: differential reference-only cross-checks within bounded-wire-profile-v1 caps; failures become Uncovered, not verdicts

independent_z3_plan.encoding: separate from reference; each operator mapped to Z3 BitVec/Bool/Array, never reusing reference host functions
independent_z3_plan.bw_read_u16be: select-byte expressions over Array(BV32,BV8) or Seq; range guard as precondition
independent_z3_plan.bw_write_u16be: Array store of Concat(Extract) bytes; guard asserted
independent_z3_plan.bw_ones_sum16: unrolled fold over fixed max segment length 92 octets (bounded profile); 16-bit BV add with end-around carry via (a+b)+(a+b>>16), final &0xFFFF; no loop over unbounded length
independent_z3_plan.udp4_checksum_compute: compose; complement then ITE(result==0,65535,result) tagged transmit_policy
independent_z3_plan.rejection: operator outside bounded profile or non-even unexpected input -> ModelError surfaced as unsat-negation case / reject case, not silently widened
independent_z3_plan.claim_scope: relative Z3-vs-reference equivalence only within bounded profile; not universal proof; no claim of solver completeness

c_generation_plan.per_operator: each IR operator lowered to a separate pure C function (uint8_t/uint16_t arrays, size_t offsets, explicit return codes WIRE_OK/WIRE_UNCOVERED/WIRE_ERR)
c_generation_plan.arith_widths: uint16_t for u16 ops; uint32_t accumulator for ones_sum16 fold with explicit 16-bit mask; end-around carry by (acc=(acc&0xFFFF)+(acc>>16), repeat until <=0xFFFF); no implicit promotion assumptions; no signedness bleed
c_generation_plan.zero_pad_even: caller-provided even scratch buffer, size bounded by wire cap 92+1; no malloc of unbounded length
c_generation_plan.policy: transmit-map and absent-acceptance emitted only where model IR explicitly places them; lowering is syntax-driven from IR, not hand-coded protocol logic
c_generation_plan.rejection: out-of-range/shape violations return WIRE_ERR at runtime and are rejected at codegen if statically provable; unsupported operator -> codegen rejects, produces no C
c_generation_plan.claim_scope: lowering target is a second executable model for differential testing within caps; no claim of compiler correctness or production readiness

acceptance_cases.note: 5 data octets incl NUL (byte 0x00); length field=13; carries odd-byte pad for checksum
acceptance_cases.expected: checksum computed over pseudoheader||segment||0x00; case is a differential fixture not a proof of RFC conformance

acceptance_cases.note: zero-length datagram, all-zero addends; arithmetic complement=0 so transmit_policy maps to 0xFFFF
acceptance_cases.expected: udp4_checksum_compute returns 65535 under transmit_policy; arithmetic bw_ones_complement16 alone returns 0 (separated)

acceptance_cases.note: transmitted checksum field = 0 means absent (policy); verify returns true
acceptance_cases.expected: udp4_checksum_verify -> true (absent policy); not an arithmetic claim

acceptance_cases.note: 2 data octets 0x00,0xFF; zero checksum in field treated as absent; provided fixture exercises bw_zero_pad_even identity branch (already even) and NUL-leading payload
acceptance_cases.expected: udp4_checksum_verify -> true (absent); pad identity is a pure-arithmetic step, policy separated

remaining_gaps: Transmit-map 0->65535 and absent-acceptance are protocol-policy IR expressions authored by the model, not by the arithmetic operators; policy wiring must be reviewed per model.
Bounded profile caps (92-octet segment) intentionally narrower than RFC max 65507; widening requires IR change and re-checked encodings, not silent relax.
Reference/Z3/C are three artifacts; any equivalence claim limited to bounded profile and finite fixtures, no universal proof.
No full IPv4 stack, fragmentation, ICMP, or host-stack substitution; absent IPv4 header checksum policy is stated as a model expression, not implemented as IP layer.
Runtime C codegen rejection cases and solver timeout behavior not characterized here; no production-readiness or successful-test claim.
No signed64 arithmetic introduced; if future protocols need it, additive operators required with explicit width rules.
